description: This file defines the class GroupedTabStructure, which manages the structure of tabs in the SuiteCRM interface, including methods for retrieving and assembling tab configurations with support for patches, invisible modules, and iframe integration.

classes.name: GroupedTabStructure
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing and managing the tab structure in SuiteCRM, including handling module lists, patches, and iframe tabs.

methods.name: get_tab_structure
methods.description: Generates the complete tab-group structure, optionally merging patches, handling invisible modules, and iframe tabs, with options for labeling keys.
